method: Blind visual scan at 1-2 fps, followed by 5-8 fps candidate verification and final cut-boundary review.

action_units.name: two_variant_hand_reveal
action_units.action: two finished fish-character cases move into frame in both hands
action_units.state_after: two finished variants held side by side
action_units.new_information: product identity, human scale, visible variants
action_units.reason: Final overhead pair payoff is cleaner and avoids redundant variant proof.

action_units.name: lower_shell_insertion
action_units.state_before: lower character shell empty; white earbud charging case separate
action_units.action: white charging case slides into lower shell
action_units.state_after: charging case seated in lower shell
action_units.take_reason: Clean insertion that continues into the complete assembly chain.

action_units.name: top_shell_fit_and_open
action_units.state_before: charging case seated in lower shell; matching face/top piece separate
action_units.action: fit top piece, then open the assembled lid
action_units.state_after: fully assembled character case open with earbuds visible
action_units.new_information: assembly completion and normal earbud access

action_units.name: carabiner_carry_display
action_units.state_before: finished closed case off frame and already connected to carabiner
action_units.action: bring case into frame suspended from carabiner and hold
action_units.state_after: case hangs visibly from finger by carabiner
action_units.proof_limit: Demonstrates hanging configuration, not the clipping-on action itself.

action_units.name: tail_detach_port_reveal
action_units.state_before: finished closed case with tail piece attached
action_units.action: rotate product and pull tail piece away
action_units.state_after: tail piece separate; bottom USB-C-shaped port visible
action_units.new_information: charging-port access and removable structural piece
action_units.proof_limit: No external cable, charging animation, or charging-success feedback is shown; classified as port-access proof only.

action_units.name: two_variant_overhead_pullback
action_units.state_before: tight overhead crop on finished products
action_units.state_after: two finished product variants readable together
action_units.new_information: variant summary and clean payoff composition
action_units.take_reason: Smoother pullback and earlier two-product readability.
